title: Joint application of Harbor Electric Company and Boston Edison Company for approval of (I) amendment to the Articles of Organization of Harbor Electric Energy Company; (ii) a $45,000,000 financing plan consisting of (a) the issuance by Harbor Electric Energy Company of up to an aggregate of $45,000,000 long-term debt securities ,and (b) the investment of up to $11,250,000 by Boston Edison Company in Harbor Electric Energy Company, (iii) short-term advances by Boston Edison Company, (iv) an Electric Power Supply Agreement between Boston Edison Company and the Massachusetts Water Resources Authority, (v) an Interconnection and Facilities Support Agreement between Boston Edison Company, Harbor Electric Energy Company and the Massachusetts Water Resources Authority and (vi) a Tax Sharing Agreement and certain investments by Boston Edison Company and Harbor Electric Energy Company pursuant thereto.
